title: EXAGREE: Mitigating Explanation Disagreement with Stakeholder-Aligned Models
reasoning: The paper introduces the EXAGREE framework for aligning AI explanations with stakeholder preferences. It utilizes a Large Language Model (LLM) interface for user feedback but evaluates fairness and bias metrics on tabular data models (ANNs and Logistic Regressors) rather than benchmarking LLMs or NLP systems. The study does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
